name: Superscription
overview: The superscription on the cross, as recorded in the Gospels, explicitly identifies Jesus as 'The King of the Jews,' emphasizing His rightful kingship even in the moment of crucifixion. Each Gospel account highlights this title being written above Him in different languages or forms, underscoring the universal significance of His identity and the fulfillment of His messianic role. This inscription serves as a powerful testimony to Christ's authority and the divine purpose of His sacrifice.
